name: Drinking Drugs And Smoking
overview: Scripture warns against the misuse of drinking, strong drink, and related substances, highlighting the dangers of intoxication and its consequences. Leviticus 10:9 commands abstinence from wine and strong drink when serving in holy duties, emphasizing purity before God. Proverbs 20:1 and Isaiah 5:11-22 caution that wine and strong drink deceive and inflame, leading to folly and woe. Habakkuk 2:15 condemns causing others to become drunk for exploitative purposes, underscoring the harm in enabling such behavior.
